purpose: Evidence collection for PvP recommendations; not approved presets or measured results
notes: Secondary articles attribute builds to named Global players or aggregated Global public builds; Questlog original build links and results still require manual primary verification.
Repeated copies, high Combat Power, likes, and character representation do not prove PvP win-rate advantage.
Only four equipped Global stigma slots; KR/TW six-slot setups excluded. PvP contexts may require conditional swaps per enemy matchup and team composition.
No automatic deployment: research inputs only. Skills and mechanics must be rechecked against latest official Global tooltip and patch.
Observed gear-score ranks must be rescaled to the user's actual available total stigma points and class/goal, not copied regardless of budget.

rankingContext.limitation: Population-adjusted top-5% representation indices do not link a named public build to an actual player victory.
